description: This file defines API routes for managing orders in a food delivery backend using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for creating carts, retrieving orders, updating items, placing orders, listing orders, and updating order statuses. It handles role-based access control, order validation, and integration with database models and schemas.

classes.name: OrderOut
classes.description: Response schema for returning order details to clients.

methods.name: OrderOut create_cart( payload: CartCreateRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Creates a new cart (order with status CREATED) for an authenticated customer.

methods.name: OrderOut get_order( order_id: UUID, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Fetches an order by its UUID, ensuring customer ownership.

methods.name: OrderOut upsert_cart_item( order_id: UUID, payload: CartItemUpsertRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Adds or updates a menu item in the cart; only allowed if order is in CREATED status.

methods.name: OrderOut remove_cart_item( order_id: UUID, payload: CartItemRemoveRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Removes a menu item from the cart if present.

methods.name: OrderOut place_order( order_id: UUID, payload: PlaceOrderRequest, current_user: User = Depends(require_roles(["customer", "admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Transitions a cart into a placed, paid order, snapshotting current menu prices.

methods.name: list[OrderOut] list_orders( status_filter: Optional[OrderStatus] = Query(None, description="Optional status filter."), customer_user_id: Optional[int] = Query( None, description="Admin-only: filter by customer user id." ), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Lists orders for the current user, with optional filters, role-dependent.

methods.name: OrderOut update_order_status( order_id: UUID, payload: UpdateOrderStatusRequest, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Changes the status of an order with role-based permissions and validation.
